title: Volunteers in the Smart City: Comparison of Contribution Strategies on Human-Centered Measures
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects related to faith or religion. It evaluates resource management algorithms in smart city applications based on metrics like privacy, fairness, social welfare, efficiency, and success rate.
findings: The paper does not analyze any aspects of religion or faith. Its focus is on comparing contribution strategies for smart city services, such as participatory sensing and smart grids, using human-centered measures like privacy and fairness.
